answer: Your records don't settle this. There is no allergy recorded anywhere in them, but there is also no entry saying "no known allergies" - the allergy list simply isn't there at all. So I can't tell you that you have no allergies, only that none have been written down in the records I have, which come from one hospital (Cascade North) between 2022 and October 2026. What I can say is that you have taken metformin (2022 to April 2024), and were prescribed Jardiance (empagliflozin) and atorvastatin in February 2025, and you had a CT scan with contrast dye in July 2025, and nothing in the records notes a reaction to any of these. If you know of anything you react to, such as a medicine, food, latex or contrast dye, it is worth asking your doctor's office to add it, or to record "no known allergies" if that is the case, so it is on file.
short: No allergy or intolerance entries, and no 'no known allergies' entry, appear in my records from Cascade North (2022-2026); please confirm and record my allergy status.
